change_summary: Reconstructed all 480 hash-frozen long strategy paths across the exact three classic calendars, assigned them to eight predeclared source-mechanism buckets, and exhaustively searched 39,798 capital-neutral 1% vectors plus 495 fixed-radius 0.25% local vectors against the 100% cash-feasible core. The experiment changed no production policy or order path.
why_result_happened: The cash-feasible core dominated every nonzero joint allocation on the declared classic objective. The least harmful global nonzero vector was 1% allocator_policy and 99% core, but it still reduced aggregate EV by 0.030593885024 and PnL by $661.45. At the finer grid, even 0.25% allocator_policy reduced EV by 0.007618242600 and PnL by $165.52. The old_thin-trained 5% allocator_policy plus 5% macro_derivatives vector then lost 0.112700825513 EV and $3,861.49 in mid_weak OOS. Recent forward rows showed only regulatory_event positive, but its 5% hindsight allocation implied just $59.27 versus cash and was excluded from selection.
forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune the same eight bucket definitions, total budget, per-bucket cap, objective, grid, recent sleeve mapping, or response shape on the exp-20260716-011 frozen paths. Do not promote the recent 5% regulatory-event hindsight result or repeat individual-strategy winner selection on these reused classic windows.
new_evidence_required: Reopen only with a prospectively pre-frozen joint portfolio ledger containing complete daily MTM paths across multiple regimes, a materially new strategy family/data source, or an owner-authorized execution/risk gate shape backed by new evidence. A new forward panel must support cash, correlation, ticker concentration, drawdown, ES95, and chronological OOS measurement rather than settled-trade totals alone.
